name: Sacramento Valley Floodplain Enhancement for Salmon and Shorebirds
summary: NFWF funding, with USDA NRCS and the US Fish and Wildlife Service, for multi-benefit floodplain restoration that improves habitat for salmon and migratory shorebirds in the Sacramento River Basin.

amount.note: Estimated award range per project for the 2025 round

status.quote: Sacramento Valley Floodplain Enhancement For Salmon and Shorebirds 2025 Request For Proposals - CLOSED

deadline.quote: Full Proposal Due Date August 5, 2025, 8:59 PM PDT/11:59 PM EDT

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants include: non-profit 501(c) organizations, state government agencies, local governments, municipal governments, Tribal governments and organizations, special districts (e.g., conservation districts, planning districts, utility districts), and educational institutions.

geography.quote: multi-benefit floodplain restoration projects that enhance habitat for anadromous fish and migratory shorebirds while also advancing the long-term health of the Sacramento River Basin

access.quote: All application materials must be submitted online through National Fish and Wildlife Foundation's Easygrants system.

amount.quote: NFWF anticipates awarding eight to 12 projects with an estimated award range of $200,000 - $500,000 per project.

co_finance_required.quote: While matching contributions are not required
